properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: liboqs itself. Its ~23k sites include the scheme dispatch tables (src/sig/sig.c: ML-DSA, Falcon, plus the on-ramp families with no dedicated objects — MAYO at :28, CROSS at :32, MQOM at :80, UOV/OV at :50-55; src/kem/kem.c: NTRU-HPS/HRSS at :~70+) and the central CSPRNG (src/common/rand/rand.c: OQS_randombytes dispatch defaulting to OpenSSL RAND_bytes with /dev/urandom fallback — secure). All shipped, all post-quantum or provider-layer code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 36 per-algorithm copies of the UOV randombytes wrapper (src/sig/uov/pqov_*/utils_randombytes.c:30) calling OpenSSL RAND_bytes — the CSPRNG behind UOV secret-key generation. The library's central OQS_randombytes (src/common/rand/rand.c) is filed separately as a new finding.
